### Safety checklist

- [ ] Exact stable identity; no display-name-only matching.
- [ ] No scripts, commands, Registry edits, file changes, process killing, elevation, downloads, or security changes.
- [ ] No secrets, personal paths, controller serials, ROMs, copyrighted assets, or diagnostics.
- [ ] Schema and compatibility/security tests pass.
- [ ] At least one maintainer review requested; two for provider-wide/high-impact rules.
